lines.zh: 我在洞穴里走，脚底是碎石。
lines.en: I walk through the cave, gravel shifting underfoot.

lines.zh: 白天我躲着，夜里才出来走。
lines.en: By day I hide; only at night do I come out.

lines.zh: 沙土在我脚下陷进去一寸。
lines.en: Sand sinks an inch under each of my steps.

lines.zh: 我沿着矿道走，肩膀蹭着石壁。
lines.en: I follow the mine shaft, my shoulder scraping the wall.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可我不会停。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 每一步都扬起一点干土。
lines.en: Every step kicks up a little dry dust.

lines.zh: 我从尸壳的旧路上回来。
lines.en: I come back along the old husk road.

lines.zh: 夜里风大，我的皮吹得发响。
lines.en: The night wind is strong and my dry skin rattles.

lines.zh: 我绕着洞口走了三圈才进去。
lines.en: I circle the cave mouth three times before entering.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片菌毯，它认得我。
lines.en: I cross a patch of mycelium, and it knows me.

lines.zh: 我停一下，听有没有人跟来。
lines.en: I pause and listen for anyone following.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘上走，脚印很快就没了。
lines.en: I cross the dune, and my prints vanish quickly.

lines.zh: 我蹲在暗处，等脚步声。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark and wait for footsteps.

lines.zh: 干皮从我的脸颊上翘起来。
lines.en: Dry skin peels up from my cheek.

lines.zh: 我把手指插进沙子，慢慢地。
lines.en: I push my fingers into the sand, slowly.

lines.zh: 洞顶在滴水，我数着听。
lines.en: Water drips from the roof; I count each drop.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，胸口也不动。
lines.en: I do not breathe, and my chest stays still.

lines.zh: 一双眼睛在远处，我没有过去。
lines.en: Eyes watch from a distance; I do not go over.

lines.zh: 沙从我指间漏完了。
lines.en: The sand runs out between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我在等夜，夜比白天安全。
lines.en: I wait for night; night is safer than day.

lines.zh: 我的下巴挂着一块旧布。
lines.en: An old scrap of cloth hangs from my jaw.

lines.zh: 有蝙蝠飞过，我抬了下头。
lines.en: A bat flits past, and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，指头卡住了。
lines.en: I try to make a fist, and my fingers stick.

lines.zh: 我坐着，等袭击的号角响。
lines.en: I sit and wait for the raid horn to sound.

lines.zh: 我数着洞穴里的岔路，四条。
lines.en: I count the cave's side passages: four of them.

lines.zh: 风从洞口进来，带着土味。
lines.en: Wind comes in from the cave mouth, tasting of dust.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进臂弯，听洞里的风。
lines.en: I bury my head in my arms and listen to the cave wind.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我的肋骨里钻出来透口气。
lines.en: Hyphae push out of my ribs for a breath of air.

lines.zh: 我在数岩壁上的裂缝，十七条。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the rock wall. Seventeen.

lines.zh: 有东西在我胸腔里，慢慢挪。
lines.en: Something inside my chest shifts, slowly.

lines.zh: 火把的光里，你的影子很清楚。
lines.en: In the torchlight your shadow is very clear.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子有点僵。
lines.en: I raise my head; my neck is a little stiff.

lines.zh: 你站在洞口，把光挡住了。
lines.en: You stand in the cave mouth, blocking the light.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手腕，那里跳得很快。
lines.en: I watch your wrist, where the pulse races.

lines.zh: 你的护甲闪了一下，我认得铁。
lines.en: Your armour glints; I know iron when I see it.

lines.zh: 我偏头，干皮掉了一块。
lines.en: I tilt my head and a flake of skin falls.

lines.zh: 你身上的布料，还是干净的。
lines.en: The cloth on you is still clean.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，喉咙里全是沙。
lines.en: I open my mouth; my throat is full of sand.

lines.zh: 你不该下到这个洞穴来。
lines.en: You should not have come down into this cave.

lines.zh: 你站的这块沙地，我记下了。
lines.en: This patch of sand you stand on — I have marked it.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，眼睛睁得很大。
lines.en: Your eyes go wide when you look at me.

lines.zh: 别举盾，先听我说完。
lines.en: Lower the shield and hear me out first.

lines.zh: 疼，可是我的皮没什么感觉。
lines.en: It hurts, though my skin barely feels it.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的臂上，沙子掉下来。
lines.en: You cut my arm, and sand falls out of it.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，又站稳了。
lines.en: I stagger once, then steady myself again.

lines.zh: 这伤口不深，我本来就空。
lines.en: The cut is shallow; I was hollow anyway.

lines.zh: 你又打中我的头，没什么用。
lines.en: You hit my head again; it does little.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，沙到膝盖。
lines.en: I fall back a step; sand reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，指缝里流沙。
lines.en: I press the wound and sand runs through my fingers.

lines.zh: 你这一下，震得我骨头响。
lines.en: That blow rattles my bones.

lines.zh: 我受伤的时候，菌丝会收得更紧。
lines.en: When I am hurt, the mycelium pulls tighter.

lines.zh: 菌丝正在替我缝合伤口。
lines.en: The mycelium is stitching my wounds for me.

lines.zh: 你手里的腐肉，我很久没吃了。
lines.en: That rotten flesh in your hand — I have not eaten in ages.

lines.zh: 我跟着那味道走了两步。
lines.en: I follow that smell two steps closer.

lines.zh: 骨头也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Bone will do too; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 我伸手，动作比想的快。
lines.en: I reach out faster than I meant to.

lines.zh: 你摇着那块肉，我的下巴在动。
lines.en: You wave the meat, and my jaw starts working.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我还是想要。
lines.en: I am not hungry, yet I still want it.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的旧肉味，骗不了我。
lines.en: The old meat smell under the sand does not fool me.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下，我慢慢爬过去。
lines.en: You drop it, and I crawl over slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得吃过一次熟的东西。
lines.en: I remember eating something cooked, once.

lines.zh: 别拿走，我已经闻到第二次了。
lines.en: Do not take it away; this is the second time I have smelled it.

lines.zh: 你踢起一片沙，我眯了眼。
lines.en: You kick up sand, and I screw my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你的手会沾上灰。
lines.en: Bump into me and your hand comes away grey.

lines.zh: 我比你矮，可我不退。
lines.en: I am shorter than you, and I do not give ground.

lines.zh: 我们在窄道里挤了一下。
lines.en: We squeeze past each other in the narrow tunnel.

lines.zh: 你撞得我踉跄，沙落了一地。
lines.en: You knock me off balance and sand spills everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的手搭在你背上，很轻。
lines.en: My hand rests on your back, very lightly.

lines.zh: 你退开，我不追，只看着。
lines.en: You pull away; I do not chase, only watch.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨硌人，你自己小心。
lines.en: My shoulder bone is sharp; mind yourself.

lines.zh: 别踩我的脚，它已经裂了。
lines.en: Do not tread on my foot; it has already split.

lines.zh: 你让路，我也会让。
lines.en: If you make room, I will make room too.

lines.zh: 袭击之后，我们会有更多同伴。
lines.en: After the raid, we will have more company.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你的肩上，不重。
lines.en: I set my hand on your shoulder, without weight.

lines.zh: 你的皮还是软的，会好起来。
lines.en: Your skin is still soft; it will take well.

lines.zh: 我们蹲在一起，像两块石头。
lines.en: We crouch together like two stones.

lines.zh: 三十秒就够，你别动。
lines.en: Thirty seconds is all it takes; hold still.

lines.zh: 我会等你站起来。
lines.en: I will wait for you to stand up again.

lines.zh: 洞穴里两个影子，比一个好。
lines.en: Two shadows in this cave beat one.

lines.zh: 沙会盖住我们，天亮前不会有人来。
lines.en: Sand will cover us; no one comes before dawn.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸停了，我还在等。
lines.en: Your breathing has stopped, and I am still waiting.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我们各自回洞里去。
lines.en: At dawn we each crawl back into our own holes.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨头，插在腰上。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and tuck it in my belt.

lines.zh: 这半块腐肉，留着夜里吃。
lines.en: Half a piece of rotten flesh; I keep it for tonight.

lines.zh: 铁片归我，我缺一块护甲。
lines.en: The iron scrap is mine; I am short one plate.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡沙里的东西，很慢。
lines.en: I bend for the thing in the sand, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我拾起破布，缠在手腕上。
lines.en: I pick up the torn cloth and wind it round my wrist.

lines.zh: 我拾起你的盾牌碎片，留着挡沙。
lines.en: I pick up a shard of your shield to keep the sand off.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，试试重量。
lines.en: I pick up a stone to test its weight.

lines.zh: 这顶破帽，正好挡沙。
lines.en: This battered hat will do to keep the sand off.

lines.zh: 我捡东西的时候，关节响得厉害。
lines.en: When I stoop to pick things up, my joints crack loudly.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，我替你拿着。
lines.en: You dropped something; I will hold it for you.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我喉里伸出来了。
lines.en: Mycelium is pushing out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，风把你送来了。
lines.en: I raise my head; the wind has brought you here.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的脚步声，只有一个。
lines.en: Only one set of footsteps in this cave.

lines.zh: 我选定你了，从这一声开始。
lines.en: I have chosen you, starting with that sound.

lines.zh: 你站在光里，等于举着旗。
lines.en: Standing in the light, you may as well wave a flag.

lines.zh: 我的目标是那个还在走的人。
lines.en: My target is the one still walking.

lines.zh: 你千万别跑，跑了更明显。
lines.en: Do not run; running only makes you easier to spot.

lines.zh: 我已经记住你的呼吸声了。
lines.en: I have already learned the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 别往岔路走，那里有我。
lines.en: Do not take the side passage; I am in there.

lines.zh: 这一波，我是第一个到你面前的。
lines.en: This wave, I am the first to reach you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的步子数，一二。
lines.en: I count your steps with you: one, two.

lines.zh: 你退到沙里，脚步就沉了。
lines.en: Back into the sand, and your steps get heavy.

lines.zh: 我侧身，把肩膀对着你。
lines.en: I turn sideways and aim my shoulder at you.

lines.zh: 我等你先出拳，甲太厚了。
lines.en: I let you swing first; your armour is thick.

lines.zh: 你抬手的时候，肋骨空出来了。
lines.en: When you raise your arm, your ribs are exposed.

lines.zh: 我在数你还剩几步到墙。
lines.en: I am counting how many steps you have to the wall.

lines.zh: 你第三根手指在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your third finger is shaking; I see it.

lines.zh: 别举盾，那挡不住我这一口。
lines.en: That shield will not stop this bite.

lines.zh: 你离我三步，很近。
lines.en: Three steps between us; that is close.

lines.zh: 我等你自己走进我的范围。
lines.en: I wait for you to walk into my reach.

lines.zh: 我咬在你手上，三十秒。
lines.en: I bite your hand; thirty seconds now.

lines.zh: 这一爪挠开你的袖子。
lines.en: This claw opens up your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的拳头不重，可它带菌。
lines.en: My fist is not heavy, but it carries fungus.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，我还是抓到肩。
lines.en: You block once, and I still catch your shoulder.

lines.zh: 沙飞起来，我趁这个空档打。
lines.en: Sand flies up; I strike in that gap.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚踝，往下拉。
lines.en: I grab your ankle and pull downward.

lines.zh: 你退了，我跟着进了半步。
lines.en: You retreat, and I step half a pace in.

lines.zh: 打了六点伤害，正好。
lines.en: Six points of damage — that will do.

lines.zh: 我的手指抠进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My fingers dig into the gap of your armour.

lines.zh: 你打回来的那一下，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the blow you gave back.

lines.zh: 我从沙里爬出来，天正黑。
lines.en: I climb out of the sand while the sky is dark.

lines.zh: 号角一响，我就在队伍里了。
lines.en: The horn sounds, and I am already in the ranks.

lines.zh: 这个洞穴原本是我躺的地方。
lines.en: This cave is where I was lying.

lines.zh: 尸壳死了，我接着站起来。
lines.en: The husk died; I stand up in its place.

lines.zh: 我从暗处来，身上还带着土。
lines.en: I come from the dark, still carrying soil.

lines.zh: 我等这一刻等了很久。
lines.en: I have waited a long time for this moment.

lines.zh: 袭击需要我，所以我来了。
lines.en: The raid called for me, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我站直的时候，沙子从背上滑下来。
lines.en: As I straighten, sand slides off my back.

lines.zh: 天黑了，该我出来了。
lines.en: It is dark now, and my turn to come out.

lines.zh: 我记得这片沙，也记得怎么杀人。
lines.en: I remember this sand, and I remember how to kill.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里慢慢亮起来。
lines.en: My eyes slowly brighten in the dark.

lines.zh: 又一个尸壳被菌吃空了。
lines.en: Another husk has been eaten hollow by fungus.

lines.zh: 火贴上来，我的皮裂着响。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my cracked skin pops.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我的腿折了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my leg folds.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，沙全变成泥。
lines.en: Water pours in my mouth and the sand turns to mud.

lines.zh: 炸得我半边身子埋进沙里。
lines.en: The blast buries half of me in sand.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩窝，我没拔出来。
lines.en: The arrow sinks into my shoulder; I leave it there.

lines.zh: 法术打在胸口，像被水淋了。
lines.en: The spell hits my chest like cold water.

lines.zh: 我从来吃不饱，也从来没死。
lines.en: I have never eaten my fill, and never starved either.

lines.zh: 雷把我的骨头照得发白。
lines.en: The lightning turns my bones white for a moment.

lines.zh: 虚空没有沙，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There is no sand in the void; I cannot grip a thing.
